notes.title: Thank you so much for the support
notes.content:
[h1][b]Heyyyoo everyone![/b][/h1]

It's been 1.5 months since Little Wings Deliveries released, and it's amazing to see many of you enjoying the Skye's journey above fluffy clouds. We just wanted to thank you all for reviewing our game positively, it means a lot to us! 

We fixed a problem with the ship that some of you were encountering. We fixed the save system to properly save your ship's last docked position and it's no longer disabled randomly (yaaay) :')

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3457390/1cb307a92b1d16af51b631ac03e134a53b0779c0/ss_1cb307a92b1d16af51b631ac03e134a53b0779c0.1920x1080.jpg?t=1747128330[/img]

[h2][b]NEW GAME?!?!?![/b][/h2]
We're working on a very cool game right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720110/PULLBACK_RACERS/
If you enjoyed Little Wings Deliveries, it's nothing like that. But we're hoping that you'll still like it anyways :) 

Here's the description: [i]Pull-back your toy car and race through gravity-defying tracks with your friends! After each round, the track bends, twists, and evolves with everyone’s choices -adding bombs, traps, and more. Watch harmless tracks turn into chaotic deathtraps, get upgrades. Buy 1, get 1 free![/i]

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3720110/extras/pullbackracers-gameplay-loop-track.png?t=1747330742[/img]

Cheers,
TENSTACK <3

notes.title: LITTLE WINGS DELIVERIES IS OUT NOW! (and some hot-fixes lol)
notes.content:
[b]Our Release Trailer, yaay![/b]
[previewyoutube=UKsFa81mBEs;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for everyone who played the game so far and leave very positive reviews, as we're standing on %100 Positive rating on Steam (we're beyond happy for that)!

[i]We also heard about some bugs (boooo!) popped up here and there, so we squashed them today![/i]

If you want to chat about the game and join our community, please join our Discord: https://discord.gg/8GZwxBqhxN


We hope you'all enjoy your time at Cloudburg!
TENSTACK <3
